title: Reorganize
summary: REOR'GANIZE, verb transitive [re and organize.] To organize anew; to reduce again to a regular body, or to a system; as, to reorganize a society or an army.

inlines.v: REOR'GANIZE, verb transitive [re and organize.] To organize anew; to reduce again to a regular body, or to a system; as, to reorganize a society or an army.
